findings.evidence: KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md:178 rejects finding A35-005 with: 'That item is scoped to AI-provider hints (LAB_ASSISTANT_*); the audit killed the server during a standard (faculty-text) hint, which is the documented R16-A-02 behaviour. Not changed.' The finding JSON (reports/test-e2e/r35/round-1/wave-A-findings.json, A35-005) says the opposite about the test: 'SIGKILL 500 ms into a 1.5 s assistant call, restart -> hint_log row (level 1, source standard, text ...) and hints_total 1' (wave A notes: assistant faked with a 0.4-1.5 s delay). So the AI-provider path WAS the one tested. Code confirms the auditor: be/src/game.ts hintLocked() inserts the hint_log row with the standard text in the same transaction as the charge (comment 'R16-A-02 ... A stop between the two steps leaves the learner with the standard hint'), and KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md:120 (R16-A-02) says 'after a restart step.hintsGiven lists the standard hint'. Yet KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md:40 still states that stopping the server during an AI hint 'keeps the hint penalty without delivering the text ... such a hint is counted but has no stored text, so it never appears in the list of earlier hints'. The document therefore contradicts itself (line 40 vs line 120), contradicts the code, and its 'Contested' paragraph misdescribes what the auditor did. Not P1: the stale line overstates a limitation, it hides nothing.
findings.fix_hint: Delete or rewrite line 40 (point to R16-A-02) and correct the 'Contested' bullet: A35-005 was right (it used an assistant call); mark it 'corrected' instead of 'not changed'.

findings.evidence: Reproduced on a scratch DB (API 3951): student 'Idle Joiner' (no attempt at all) joined class Alpha and class Beta of the same teacher; I set Alpha membership joined_at to 10 days earlier. GET /classes/<Alpha>/students -> active:false, needsAttention:true, attentionReason 'No activity for 10 days', lastActiveAt:null; GET /classes/<Beta>/students -> active:true, needsAttention:false, reason null. Student detail agrees with its own roster in each class. The idle clock of a never-active student is the per-class joined_at, so the same person with identical data is flagged in one class (and in that class's cohort.needsAttention / activeStudents) and not in the other. By design (class-relative) but undocumented; the text 'No activity for 10 days' is shown with lastActiveAt null. No way for a student to leave or switch class (known item 8), so a wrongly joined class keeps counting the student.
findings.fix_hint: Document that idle time starts at the class join date, or show 'No activity since joining' for lastActiveAt = null.
